product: Base Laboratories Ingrown Hair Oil Solution (1 fl oz dropper bottle)
hand_block: The hand is the ONLY person in the video: one woman's hand, medium-dark brown skin, slim fingers, SHORT squared nails that end just past the fingertips (a short free edge of about 2 mm, much shorter than the nails in the hand reference images; use those images for skin tone, hand shape and nail colour only), with a glossy pale lilac-white base and a narrow white tip band on every nail (ignore the annotation text and leader lines in those images). Only the hand enters from the frame edge, whole wrist visible, no forearm, no face, no other people.
scene_block: Setting: a bright, clean home bathroom: white subway-tile wall, a white countertop with a small white ceramic dish and a folded white towel, soft window daylight from the left, slightly steamy air. Shot on a phone, natural light, realistic unretouched skin texture with visible knuckle creases, casual and a little lived-in like a real person filmed it, no cinematic grading. No on-screen text or captions. No other branded products. No face, no reflection of a person.
video_suffix: Fingers move naturally and stay anatomically correct (five fingers per hand). The camera does not move (locked-off camera on a tripod). No sound. No on-screen text.
prod_block: The bottle is exactly the real bottle in the reference image: a clear glass dropper bottle with a rounded-square body filled with golden-yellow oil and a glossy TEAL-GREEN metallic cap and collar on top. There is NO separate label and NO yellow or white label panel: the words 'BASE LABORATORIES' (small) and 'INGROWN HAIR OIL SOLUTION' (large, bold, condensed) are printed directly on the clear glass in teal-green letters, with three small bullet lines under them. It keeps this exact shape, colours and layout in every frame: no morphing, no extra text, no label drift. The cap is a squat, glossy TEAL-GREEN two-tier metal cylinder with a flat top (a narrower upper tier sitting on a wider lower tier), exactly as in the reference image: it is NOT a rubber bulb, NOT a dome, NOT a pointed teat.
box_block: The box beside it is the real mint-teal carton in the reference image with a red band and 'BASE LABORATORIES'.

shots.still: Medium close-up on a white bathroom countertop: the hand, entering from the bottom edge of the frame, holds the Base Laboratories glass dropper bottle upright and front-facing toward the lens; a plain pink disposable razor with no printed text lies on the counter at the lower left, a folded white towel behind it.
shots.video: Shot 1: the hand holds the bottle steady front-on for a second, then turns it very slightly toward the lens and back; the golden oil catches the window light; the razor stays on the counter.

shots.still: Close-up of a glass shower door fogged with steam, the hand entering from the right edge with fingertips on the glass, a clear wiped streak starting to show the white tiled shower wall behind; no person, no face and no reflection of a person.
shots.video: Shot 1: the hand drags one fingertip stroke down the fogged glass door, wiping a clear band through the steam, then lifts away leaving the clear streak.

shots.still: Medium close-up on the white countertop: the Base Laboratories dropper bottle stands open in frame next to its mint-teal box; the hand enters from the bottom edge and holds the squat teal two-tier cap just lifted straight up out of the bottle, with its thin glass pipette hanging below it and a golden drop of oil clinging at the glass tip.
shots.video: Shot 1: the hand holds the cap and pipette steady above the bottle; a golden oil drop swells at the glass tip, then the hand lowers the pipette slowly back into the bottle.

shots.still: Close-up of a woman's bare forearm (same medium-dark brown skin) resting palm up on the white countertop entering from the left edge of the frame, wrist at the left; the hand from the right edge touches two fingertips glistening with a drop of golden oil to the skin near the elbow end of the forearm. Nothing else on the counter.
shots.video: Shot 1: the fingertips massage the oil in slow small circles along the forearm, the skin gets a soft glossy sheen, then the fingers lift away. The forearm stays still.

shots.still: Medium close-up on the white bathroom countertop: the hand, entering from the bottom edge, holds the closed Base Laboratories dropper bottle front-facing and upright toward the lens at chest height, label fully visible and square to the camera; the mint-teal box stands on the counter just behind it.
shots.video: Shot 1: the hand holds the bottle steady front-on with only tiny natural hand movement; the bottle does NOT tilt, turn or rotate, its cap and label stay facing the lens the whole time; the golden oil shimmers slightly; the box behind stays still.
